(2) The `physics_biophysics_sandbox_isolation` enforces physical import barriers using boolean flags (`RESEARCH_SANDBOX_ONLY`, `SPORTS_SPINE_IMPORT_PERMITTED = False`), ensuring that even if a model is accidentally written to reference the spine, it will fail at runtime. Together, these primitives form a dual-layered defense: one focused on behavioral compliance (GSI-style) and the other on structural segregation (GSE-style). The `0` imports metric serves as a hard constraint, analogous to a conservation law in physics, guaranteeing no information flow across the boundary.
